_comment: Master definition of the two design targets. Numbering is resolved at runtime by aligning each template's ATOM-record sequence to the precursor in precursor.fasta, so epitope residues from different PDBs all map into one consistent frame. Mutations vs template are recorded for documentation; they are already present in the target sequence (the README sequences ARE NDM-5 / KPC-3) and are conservative/distal to the active site, so the template backbone is used as the design scaffold.

NDM5.name: New Delhi metallo-beta-lactamase 5
NDM5.template_note: Templates are NDM-1; NDM-5 = NDM-1 + V88L + M154L (distal to active site).

catalytic_pattern.standard_residues_note: His120/His122/His189 (Zn1); Asp124/Cys208/His250 (Zn2) in standard NDM numbering.

KPC3.name: Klebsiella pneumoniae carbapenemase 3
KPC3.template_note: Templates are KPC-2; KPC-3 = KPC-2 + H274Y (distal to active site).

catalytic_pattern.standard_residues_note: Ser70 (nucleophile), Lys73, Ser130, Glu166 (Omega-loop); oxyanion hole = backbone N of Ser70 + Thr237 (Ambler numbering).
